_about: Measured from @tikshop.uk's own posts (Nov 2026). All positions are fractions of a 1080x1920 slide. Text slots in {braces} come from copy.json. Fonts: TikTok Sans Medium for TikTok text boxes and outlined text; Liberation Sans (Arial-style) for the Snapchat caption bar.

DEAL-FIRST.description: Slide 1 = real screenshot of the live listing with the sale price circled in red, hook + sub text over the product image. Slide 2 = realistic faceless POV photo of the product in a natural setting, main line + bracketed sub-line + CTA.
DEAL-FIRST.needs: A real discount on the listing (a was-price or -NN%).

SNAP-CAPTION.description: Slide 1 = realistic faceless POV photo of the product (e.g. laid on a bed / counter with gift wrap), Snapchat-style caption bar near the top as if sending it to friends, plus a big white outlined line mid-slide teasing the price. Slide 2 = real listing screenshot with the sale price circled, main line + sub-line + CTA.
SNAP-CAPTION.needs: A real discount works best; without one, use snap_main lines that don't claim a discount.

cta_rule: The CTA always sits bottom-left with its bottom edge at y 0.785 and left edge at x 0.03, so it points at TikTok's product-link sticker without covering it. Never move it.
dealshot_rule: Built by render.py from a REAL screenshot of the live listing (shop.tiktok.com/gb/pdp/<id>), never redrawn or edited. Product image on top, the real price/title/sold block underneath, red loop drawn around the live sale price.
